source.title: State of Vermont Holiday Schedule - Effective July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2028 (Vermont Department of Human Resources; PDF https://humanresources.vermont.gov/sites/humanresources/files/documents/State%20of%20Vermont%20Holiday%20Schedule.pdf); 1 V.S.A. 371

stateHolidays.name: Town Meeting Day
stateHolidays.note: On the DHR 2026-2028 schedule (Tue Mar 2, 2027) and in 1 V.S.A. 371(a)(4).

stateHolidays.name: Day after Thanksgiving
stateHolidays.note: Not in the DHR holiday table, but the DHR schedule states 'Most State offices will be closed on the day after Thanksgiving (see Holiday Articles in State employee contracts).' In the VSEA Non-Management contract (2024-26, Art. 28) leave without loss of pay may be granted subject to operating needs; employees required to work get comp time.

partialOrLocal.name: Bennington Battle Day
partialOrLocal.note: Still a legal holiday in 1 V.S.A. 371(a)(8), but removed from the State's paid-holiday schedule effective July 1, 2026: not on the DHR 2026-2028 table; VSEA's 2026 ratification letter says it 'would no longer be observed' when Juneteenth and Indigenous Peoples' Day were added (Article 21). Earlier schedules (2024-25) observed it for non-management and exempt units only.

partialOrLocal.name: Administrative holiday declared by the Governor
partialOrLocal.note: Contracts allow the Governor to declare an administrative holiday; none scheduled.
